A?
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. & D.
L. O. RED
No. 589
Date 4 - 9 - 16
1st September 1916

Sir,
Yu Yah Ching 虞洽卿 called yesterday
at No. 468 Rue Eugene Bard, the headquarters of
the society for the relief of ex-revolutionaries,
where he had arranged to meet some rebel leaders
in connection with the repatriation of rebel
followers. None of the leaders turned up.

General Yang sent one of his staff officers
named Zau Li Waung 趙聯潢 to Nanking on 31st
ultimo to get money to pay the troops here.

The painters' strike is still on.

Your obedient servant,
mmmmclwshong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

A?
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探股））
上海公共租界工部局。
C. & D.
L. O. RED
第 589 号
日期 4 - 9 - 16
1916 年 9 月 1 日

先生：

虞洽卿（Yu Yah Ching）昨日前往欧仁·巴尔路（Rue Eugene Bard）468 号，即前革命党人救济会总部，他已安排在此与一些叛乱首领会面，商讨遣返叛乱追随者事宜。没有任何首领出席。

杨将军于上月 31 日派遣其一名参谋赵联潢（Zau Li Waung）前往南京，以获取资金支付此处驻军军饷。

油漆工罢工仍在继续。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmclwshong
总探长。

警察总监上尉
